pages.text: Fragile Soul gems are eggs infused by a $(#AA00AA)Foliot$(). The spirit creates a small dimension$(br) that allows the temporary entrapment of living beings.$(br) Beings of great power or size cannot be stored, however. $(br) Be careful, $()
this item will break after transporting a creature.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To capture an entity, $(#55FF55)right-click$() it with the soul gem. $(br)$(#55FF55)Right-click$() again to release the entity.$(br2)Bosses cannot be captured.$(br)
